Complete response rate under the recorded response criteria. AML CR (ELN 2022): marrow blasts <5%, no circulating or Auer-rod blasts, no extramedullary disease, ANC >=1.0 and platelets >=100 x10^9/L
Myeloma: ORR plus minimal response (>=MR, IMWG). Waldenström has no formal CBR (IWWM); treat a reported CBR as trial-defined
Progression or death within 24 months of starting first-line chemoimmunotherapy (Casulo, JCO 2015); some papers anchor on diagnosis, so record the anchor
Myeloma VGPR (IMWG 2016): M-protein detectable by immunofixation but not electrophoresis, or >=90% serum M-protein reduction and urine M-protein <100 mg/24 h. AL: VGPR is dFLC <40 mg/L
Stringent CR (IMWG 2016): CR plus normal serum FLC ratio and no clonal plasma cells in marrow by IHC or flow
CR plus CR with partial hematologic recovery. CRh (ELN 2022): CR criteria except ANC >=0.5 and platelets >=50 x10^9/L
No ELN 2022 standard; trials define it (CR + CRi, or CR + CRh + CRi). Record which components were counted
Morphologic leukemia-free state (ELN 2022): marrow blasts <5%, no Auer rods, no circulating blasts, no extramedullary disease; no count recovery required
Record assay and threshold. Myeloma (IMWG 2016): no clonal plasma cells by NGF or NGS at >=10^-5. CLL: <10^-4 (uMRD4)
Myeloma (IMWG 2016): MRD negativity in marrow confirmed at least 1 year apart
CR with MRD below the stated threshold; ELN 2022 adds MRD-negative suffixes (CR-MRDneg, CRh-MRDneg)
Share of patients who went on to allo-HCT after the study treatment
iwCLL 2018: <1 CLL cell per 10,000 leukocytes (<10^-4) in blood or marrow

Store the trial's own duration. MDS: no RBC transfusion for >=8 weeks (IWG 2006; IWG 2018 within a 16-24 week window); deeper endpoints use >=16 or >=24 weeks. MF trials define their own (e.g. >=12 weeks)
IWG 2006 (MDS): Hb rise >=1.5 g/dL, or >=4 fewer RBC units per 8 weeks, lasting >=8 weeks; IWG 2018 revises it for lower-risk MDS
Major molecular response (ELN 2020): BCR::ABL1 <=0.1% on the International Scale
>=35% reduction in spleen volume from baseline by MRI or CT; timepoint is trial-specific (usually week 24)
>=50% reduction in total symptom score (MFSAF) from baseline; timepoint is trial-specific (usually week 24)
Waldenström (IWWM-6 / IWWM-11): PR or better, i.e. >=50% IgM reduction; distinct from ORR, which includes MR (>=25%)
ISA 2012 consensus: negative serum and urine immunofixation and normal FLC ratio
Protocol-defined toxicity in the DLT window (usually cycle 1) judged unacceptable
Highest dose with a DLT rate below the target (typically <33%, e.g. <=1 of 6)
Dose chosen for phase 2 from safety, PK/PD and activity; can be below the MTD
ASTCT 2019 consensus (Lee): grades 1-4 by fever, hypotension and hypoxia; record if another system (e.g. Lee 2014, CTCAE) is used

ASTCT 2019: grade 3 = hypotension needing one vasopressor (with or without vasopressin) and/or high-flow nasal cannula, facemask, non-rebreather or Venturi mask; grade 4 = multiple vasopressors and/or positive pressure (CPAP, BiPAP, intubation)
ASTCT 2019: graded by ICE score, consciousness, seizures, motor findings and cerebral edema (CAPD for children under 12)
ASTCT 2019 grade 3-4 (e.g. ICE 0-2, seizure, or cerebral edema)
